dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, serrated perimeters. The geometry consists of a bright, jagged outer ring with a sharp gradient transition into a darker interior core, particularly prominent in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters interspersed between the macro-annuli. Scattered high-intensity pixel clusters are localized along the upper dorsal curvature, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four largest macro-annuli in the upper-mid quadrant form an asymmetrical trapezoidal configuration. Three smaller annuli towards the posterior form a linear-oblique alignment.
